why_trace.root_cause: The Stop hook stored each check event (raw cited URLs, paths and quotes) in the ledger without redaction, so a Slack webhook path or ?api_key= value in a citation was persisted in plain text.
evidence: tests/test_resolve.py RedactionRound2Test.test_hook_check_event_is_redacted writes a check event and asserts neither secret appears in events.payload
